objective: Reduce warm paired retrieval/search p95 (Cycle1 HOLD root cause) while preserving candidate-v2 lexical quality gain via bounded vector-pool lexical combination.

dev_set.creation_policy: independent builder session before tuning, overlap 0 vs P0/cycle1-dev+holdout/cycle2-dev+disqualified-holdout/hard-negative and mutual dev<->holdout

holdout_set.creation_policy: independent builder session before tuning, overlap 0, plaintext sealed until candidate freeze + independent review + user approval

candidates.description: vector-pool 128: nearest → vector_pool 128 → lexical on 128 only → youth/lexical ordering → final 30
vector-pool 256: nearest → vector_pool 256 → lexical on 256 only → youth/lexical ordering → final 30
vector-pool 512: nearest → vector_pool 512 → lexical on 512 only → youth/lexical ordering → final 30

sql_semantics.description: eligible/expired/age/rp conditions and per-policy nearest chunk (vector-pool: vector-distance pre-pool K) then lexical CTE on K only, existing youth/lexical ordering for final n=30; public region search / rerank / global threshold none; D-004 compliance; spec only in bootstrap
sql_semantics.eligible_condition: ( %(age)s IS NULL OR p.age_limit_yn IS NOT TRUE OR %(age)s BETWEEN p.age_min AND p.age_max ) AND ( %(rp)s IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p.region_codes) rc WHERE rc LIKE %(rp)s) ) AND ( p.biz_end IS NULL OR p.biz_end >= CURRENT_DATE )
sql_semantics.nearest_cte: SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.id, ... (c.embedding <=> %(vec)s::vector) AS dist FROM policy_chunk c JOIN policy p ON p.id=c.policy_id WHERE <eligible> ORDER BY p.id, c.embedding <=> %(vec)s::vector
sql_semantics.vector_pool_cte: SELECT * FROM nearest ORDER BY dist ASC LIMIT %(pool_k)s -- {128,256,512}
sql_semantics.lexical_cte: SELECT p.id, count(DISTINCT term) AS lexical_overlap FROM policy p JOIN vector_pool vp ON vp.id=p.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(%(lexical_terms)s::text[]) AS term WHERE concat_ws(' ', p.title, p.summary, p.support_content, p.add_qualify, p.keywords) ILIKE '%%' || term || '%%' GROUP BY p.id
sql_semantics.final_order: ORDER BY t.dist - CASE WHEN t.source='youth' THEN %(youth_bias)s ELSE 0 END - %(lexical_bias)s * coalesce(l.lexical_overlap,0), t.dist, t.source, t.source_id LIMIT %(n)s -- n=30
sql_semantics.template_sql: WITH nearest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.id, p.source, p.source_id, p.title, p.org, p.support_content, p.apply_method, p.apply_url, p.age_min, p.age_max, p.income_etc, (c.embedding <=> %(vec)s::vector) AS dist FROM policy_chunk c JOIN policy p ON p.id = c.policy_id WHERE ( %(age)s IS NULL OR p.age_limit_yn IS NOT TRUE OR %(age)s BETWEEN p.age_min AND p.age_max ) AND ( %(rp)s IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p.region_codes) rc WHERE rc LIKE %(rp)s) ) AND ( p.biz_end IS NULL OR p.biz_end >= CURRENT_DATE ) ORDER BY p.id, c.embedding <=> %(vec)s::vector ), vector_pool AS ( SELECT * FROM nearest ORDER BY dist ASC LIMIT %(pool_k)s ), lexical AS ( SELECT p.id, count(DISTINCT term) AS lexical_overlap FROM policy p JOIN vector_pool vp ON vp.id = p.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(%(lexical_terms)s::text[]) AS term WHERE concat_ws(' ', p.title, p.summary, p.support_content, p.add_qualify, p.keywords) ILIKE '%%' || term || '%%' GROUP BY p.id ) SELECT t.source, t.source_id, t.title, t.org, t.support_content, t.apply_method, t.apply_url, t.age_min, t.age_max, t.income_etc, 1 - t.dist AS score FROM vector_pool t LEFT JOIN lexical l ON l.id = t.id ORDER BY t.dist - CASE WHEN t.source = 'youth' THEN %(youth_bias)s ELSE 0 END - %(lexical_bias)s * coalesce(l.lexical_overlap, 0), t.dist, t.source, t.source_id LIMIT %(n)s

quality_selectable_all_required: candidate source-macro Recall@5 > baseline source-macro Recall@5
candidate net hit@5 >= +2 (baseline vs candidate on same fresh dev 36)
Youth hit@5 regression 0 (candidate Youth >= baseline Youth on same 18 Youth cases)
Gov24 hit@5 regression 0 (candidate Gov24 >= baseline Gov24 on same 18 Gov24 cases)

latency_gate.methodology: same-process / same-DB / interleaved / warmup-excluded (D-007 warm paired, timed count fixed before inspection, cold/model-load excluded)
latency_gate.required: candidate p95 <= paired baseline p95 (same dev query set, same run/window)

dev_selection_rule.if_none_dev_selectable: Cycle3 candidate search closes without holdout evaluation
dev_selection_rule.holdout_gating: P0/hard-negative/final holdout only after candidate freeze + independent review + user explicit approval; final holdout evaluated with D-007 7 mandatory gates without additional tuning

audit_log.chain: previous_event_hash + event_hash (SHA256 over canonical JSON excluding event_hash), truncate/overwrite or broken chain fails closed
audit_log.holdout_access_contract: event append (protected_access_start) must succeed before plaintext open; test enforces fail-closed

fingerprint.query_fingerprint: SHA256(normalized_query) where normalized = strip + NFC + join-with-single-space + lower (pure helper; spec defines normalization variants but helper exposes deterministic function)
fingerprint.gold_fingerprint: SHA256(source + NUL + source_id) where source in {youth,gov24}
fingerprint.overlap_check: pure helper check_overlap(manifest_a, manifest_b) → fail-closed overlap 0 for both query and gold; no plaintext read
fingerprint.bootstrap_prohibition: no fresh dev/holdout generation, no existing cycle1/2 protected plaintext read to create new fingerprints

prohibitions_bootstrap: no fresh dev/holdout plaintext generation or access
no existing cycle1/2 dev/holdout plaintext viewing
no existing eval result artifact modification
Web does not intervene before Paseo completes
